services.long_description: Quality siding installation and replacement that protects your home from the elements while boosting energy efficiency and visual appeal. We also install and repair soffit and fascia to protect your roof edges and improve ventilation.

services.long_description: Expert chimney repair, repointing, and cap installation. We ensure your chimney is safe, functional, and weather-tight, including structural repair and waterproofing.

services.title: Skylights & Painting
services.short_description: Professional skylight installation and repair, plus interior and exterior painting.
services.long_description: Professional skylight installation and repair to bring natural light into your home, with energy-efficient options, proper ventilation, and waterproofing. We also offer professional interior and exterior painting with quality preparation and application for a finish that lasts.

about_story:
At G&T Roofing & Home Improvements LLC, we believe that quality roofing and home improvement services should be accessible to everyone. That's why we've built our business on three core principles: honest pricing, expert craftsmanship, and exceptional customer service.

We understand that your home is your most valuable investment. Whether you need a complete roof replacement, emergency repairs, or any of our home improvement services, we approach every project with the same level of care and attention to detail. No job is too small for our team.

G&T Roofing is led by Alex and Luis, two dedicated professionals who have built their reputation on reliability, quality work, and fair pricing. Together, they ensure every project meets the highest standards of craftsmanship. We proudly use premium materials from trusted industry-leading suppliers including GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed, and IKO to ensure long-lasting quality, durability, and professional results on every project.
brand_voice_sample: Professional roofing and home improvement services serving Northeast Pennsylvania. No job is too small. 100% guaranteed best prices. Free estimates available. We stand behind our commitment to provide the most competitive pricing in Northeast Pennsylvania. Get quality workmanship without breaking the bank.
